description: ARCHIVED: Parking Citations is a dataset listed in City of Los Angeles open data portal (data.lacity.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Los Angeles. New Parking Citations dataset here: ---Archived as of September 2023--- Parking citations with latitude / longitude (XY) in US Feet coordinates according to the California State Plane Coordinate System - Zone 5 ( For more information on Geographic vs Projected coordinate systems, read here: For information on how to change map projections, read here:. Coverage: Los Angeles. The portal files it under the category Transportation. The table has 22 columns. The portal shows 2023-09-07 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-lacity-org-portal.
